en: Colorized vintage postcard view of a military training camp complex surrounded by forest and fields. In the foreground there is a fenced area with a small garden and a round gazebo-like structure. Behind it stand long red-brick barracks buildings with many windows and a small bell tower. In the distance, scattered houses and gently rolling wooded hills are visible under a pale blue sky. The title is printed in red Gothic-style script at the top.
